# Mikutap

This directory contains the visual and audio runtime from the archived
[HFIProgramming/mikutap](https://github.com/HFIProgramming/mikutap) mirror.

Original work and music: [daniwell / AIDN](https://aidn.jp/mikutap/).

The local `background.html` wrapper hides the original navigation and settings
so the interactive work can run behind this site's login controls. Original
author attribution is retained on the parent login page.
